pages.text: The Hovering Inferno victory and the twelve NPC stories are parallel achievements. Follow the finale’s quest requirements to claim Tears for Fears and four Radiation potions. Recovering the sword does not by itself complete every story or awaken a relic.

After recovering Tears for Fears, carry it in your normal inventory when speaking with a story NPC. It can be in your hotbar, main inventory or offhand; it need not be selected. A contextual Listen prompt offers their recognition while preserving ordinary quest conversations. A sword inside a backpack or other container is not in your normal inventory.

Relic awakening is experimental in this development build and is disabled in standard downloads. Where enabled for testing by the world or server owner, you must personally finish all twelve NPC stories and bring both relics to a valid Ranker’s Memorial. Defeat a Warden to obtain the Ring of Ranker; the sword comes from the Inferno victory reward.

Use the memorial plaque to make three separate offerings of 10,000 LP from its Tier 1 Blood Altar: 30,000 LP actually consumed. Refill between offerings. During the final stage, make your own successful Sacrificial Knife offering at that altar, then offer the last full basin. Friends may supply LP, but cannot make your personal sacrifice. No altar upgrades or extra offering items are required.

A successful ceremony awakens both original relics and soulbinds their awakened powers to you. Keep your own enchantments and upgrades; awakening does not replace the items. The sword gains Resonant Fracture, Echo of the Fallen and resonance. The equipped awakened ring adds Last Stand and creative-style flight; both awakened relics enable an aerial Skybreaker attack.

The Promise Fulfilled records your own completion, even when you share an FTB team. Each viewer sees their own memorial inscription and current username. The optional relic HUD shows resonance and cooldowns; use /orrelichud hide or /orrelichud show. Sword recognition remains available through the NPCs’ optional Listen replies. These new powers and the cinematic still need gameplay testing.
